dz: 英格兰女王玛丽一世的王后西班牙国王腓力二世从多佛出发与法国开战,最终导致加来城被丧失,而加来城是该大陆上最后的英国占有地,玛丽一世再也没有见到她的丈夫.
de: King Philip II of Spain, consort of Queen Mary I of England, sets out from Dover to war with France, which eventually resulted in the loss of the city of Calais, the last English possession on the continent, and Mary I never seeing her husband again.

t: 西班牙在1551–59年意大利战争中战胜法军.
te: Spanish victory over the French in the Italian War of 1551–59.
dz: 圣康坦战役:西班牙在1551–59年意大利战争中战胜法军.
de: Battle of St. Quentin: Spanish victory over the French in the Italian War of 1551–59.

t: 圣康坦战役使埃马纽埃尔·菲利伯特出任萨伏依公爵.
te: The Battle of St. Quentin results in Emmanuel Philibert becoming Duke of Savoy.
dz: 圣康坦战役使埃马纽埃尔·菲利伯特出任萨伏依公爵.
de: The Battle of St. Quentin results in Emmanuel Philibert becoming Duke of Savoy.
